tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the RPScripts catalogue of FiveM scripts, MLOs, server packs, vehicles and assets. Filter by framework, category and USD price; results are ranked by relevance when a query is given, otherwise by popularity. Only published, listed products. 24 results per page. price is the list price; checko

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Details of one RPScripts product by slug (from search_products): description (Markdown), frameworks, version, categories, list price and checkout_price (after the discount Checkout applies automatically, absent when there is none), whether it can be bought, and install requirements from RPScripts La

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: All RPScripts shop categories (scripts by framework and job, MLOs, vehicles, clothing, server packs …) with their paths and URLs.

tools.name: check_compatibility
tools.description: Checks whether an RPScripts product (by slug) or your own resource files fit a server: framework (QBCore, Qbox, ESX, vRP, standalone), required resources such as ox_lib, ox_inventory, ox_target or oxmysql, FXServer artifact and game build minimums, OneSync, and conflicts in your resource list. tools.name: validate_resource
tools.description: Statically checks a FiveM resource: Lua syntax, fxmanifest.lua directives and referenced files, resource structure, undeclared dependencies, framework API calls against pinned QBCore/Qbox/ESX versions, unknown natives, net-event security and backdoor patterns. Returns diagnostics with severity, rule

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Searches RPScripts documentation (installation, downloads, server packs, updates, QBCore/Qbox/ESX guides, compatibility, troubleshooting) and the framework API reference RPScripts reads from pinned QBCore, Qbox, ESX, ox_lib, ox_inventory, ox_target and oxmysql sources. tools.name: validate_server_cfg
tools.description: Parses and checks an FXServer server.cfg: syntax, argument counts and values, duplicate or conflicting settings, repeated resource starts, framework and ox resource start order, missing dependencies, OneSync/slot conflicts, secrets exposed with set/sets, weak RCON passwords, plain-text database pass

tools.name: generate_fxmanifest
tools.description: Generates a valid fxmanifest.lua (fx_version 'cerulean', game 'gta5') for client/server/shared Lua or JS scripts, NUI pages, maps, vehicle data files and dependencies, then validates it with the RPScripts manifest rules. Lua 5.4 is the default runtime, so no lua54 line is written.

tools.name: create_job
tools.description: Generates a complete job resource with the RPScripts Jobs Creator for QBCore, Qbox or ESX: job definition and grades with salaries and boss flags, duty, stash, garage, armory, shop, crafting, harvest/process/sell, boss office, wardrobe, teleports, billing, dispatch, player and vehicle actions, plus

tools.name: lookup_server
tools.description: Looks up a public FiveM server by cfx.re join code/link (e.g. cfx.re/join/abc123) or public host:port. Returns what the server or the Cfx server list publishes: hostname, player count, slots, artifact/build, OneSync, tags, public variables and resources. Private and local addresses are refused; offl

tools.name: list_purchases
tools.description: Lists the RPScripts products the signed-in customer owns (active purchases, including bundle items): product id, name, product page, files with their index for get_download_url, download availability and install requirements. Requires signing in to RPScripts.

tools.name: get_download_url
tools.description: Creates a signed download link for one file of a product the signed-in customer owns (from list_purchases). The link is personal, works for at least 5 minutes (longer for large files, see expires_at) and counts toward the limit of 20 downloads per product per day. Requires signing in.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "validate_server_cfg" references sensitive artifacts (password, secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
